user.title: Choose your Nimly lock
user.description: Locks paired with ZHA that are not set up yet. Lock control, battery, auto relock and volume stay in ZHA; this adds who and how, and PIN management.

discovery_confirm.title: Nimly lock found
discovery_confirm.description: ZHA has paired {name} ({ieee}). Set it up to see who locks and unlocks it and to manage its PIN codes.

reconfigure.title: Change Zigbee module
reconfigure.description: Pick the lock again after replacing its Zigbee module. Slot names, PIN codes and entities stay.

abort.already_configured: This lock is already set up.
abort.no_locks: No Nimly lock found in ZHA. Pair the lock's Zigbee module with ZHA first (wake it with a code and # on the keypad while ZHA searches).
abort.zha_not_running: ZHA is not running. Set up Zigbee Home Automation first.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The lock now uses the selected Zigbee module.

set_pin.title: Set PIN code
set_pin.description: User slots start at {first}. The code must be {min}-{max} digits. It is sent straight to the lock and not stored in Home Assistant.

data_description.valid_until: Optional. The code is removed from the lock at this time. Leave empty for a permanent code.

name_slot.title: Name a slot
name_slot.description: Name a slot so events show who it is, for example a key tag or fingerprint enrolled at the lock. An empty name removes it.

data.wake_with_lock: Wake the lock by locking it

data_description.reserved_slots: How many slots from 0 hold master codes. Home Assistant never writes a PIN to them.
data_description.wake_with_lock: When a command times out, send a lock command through ZHA to wake the radio before retrying. This moves the bolt: an open door gets locked.

error.slot_out_of_range: That slot cannot be written from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_pin: The code must be digits only and the length the lock accepts.
error.lock_unreachable: The lock did not answer. Press a key on the lock to wake it and try again.
error.lock_rejected_duplicate: The lock refused the code: it is already in use.
error.lock_rejected_memory_full: The lock refused the code: its memory is full.
error.expiry_in_past: The end time must be in the future.

abort.no_pin_codes: No slot has a PIN code set from Home Assistant.

lock_not_in_zha.message: The lock {ieee} is not in ZHA.

cluster_missing.message: The lock {ieee} is in ZHA but has no Door Lock cluster yet. Wait for ZHA to finish its interview, or reconfigure the device in ZHA.

entry_not_found.message: No Nimly lock with that config entry.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Nimly lock is not loaded.

slot_out_of_range.message: Slot {slot} cannot be used; allowed slots are {first}-{last}.

invalid_pin.message: The PIN code must be {min}-{max} digits.

lock_unreachable.message: The lock did not answer. Press a key on the lock to wake it and try again.

lock_rejected_duplicate.message: The lock refused the code: it is already in use.

lock_rejected_memory_full.message: The lock refused the code: its memory is full.

expiry_in_past.message: The end time must be in the future.

zha_internals.title: Nimly lock events cannot be received
zha_internals.description: ZHA does not offer what this integration needs to listen to the lock ({detail}). Lock control in ZHA still works. Update the integration, or report your Home Assistant version as an issue.

quirk_missing.title: ZHA runs {title} without its Nimly quirk
quirk_missing.description: ZHA did not apply a device quirk to this lock, so auto relock and sound volume are missing in ZHA and the battery level may be wrong. Make sure ZHA is up to date, then remove and re-pair the lock in ZHA (or reconfigure it). Lock activity and PIN management in this integration work either way.

expired_pin_not_cleared.title: Expired PIN code on {title} is still active
expired_pin_not_cleared.description: The temporary code for {name} (slot {slot}) has expired, but the lock has not removed it yet, so it may still open the door. Home Assistant keeps trying every 10 minutes. Press a key on the lock to wake it, or delete the code at the keypad.

set_pin.name: Set PIN code
set_pin.description: Writes a PIN code to a slot on the lock. Action data is stored by the recorder; use the integration's Configure dialog to keep the code out of the database.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: User slot; the reserved master slots cannot be written.

pin_code.name: PIN code
pin_code.description: Digits only, the length the lock accepts (usually 4-8).

name.name: Name
name.description: Who the code belongs to, shown in lock events.

valid_until.name: Valid until
valid_until.description: Remove the code at this time (temporary code). Cannot be combined with valid for.

valid_for.name: Valid for
valid_for.description: Remove the code after this long (temporary code). Cannot be combined with valid until.

clear_pin.name: Clear PIN code
clear_pin.description: Removes the PIN code from a slot. The slot keeps its name.

set_slot_name.name: Name a slot
set_slot_name.description: Names a slot so lock events show who it is. An empty name removes it.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot to name, master slots included.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name, or empty to remove it.
